	}{
		{"plain name", "${FLIPT_TEST_SUBSTITUTION}", "resolved"},
		{"leading underscore and digit", "${_FLIPT_TEST_SUBSTITUTION9}", "underscored"},
		{"empty variable value", "${FLIPT_TEST_SUBSTITUTION_EMPTY}", ""},
		{"missing variable", "${FLIPT_TEST_SUBSTITUTION_UNSET}", "${FLIPT_TEST_SUBSTITUTION_UNSET}"},
		{"leading whitespace", " ${FLIPT_TEST_SUBSTITUTION}", " ${FLIPT_TEST_SUBSTITUTION}"},
		{"prefix", "prefix-${FLIPT_TEST_SUBSTITUTION}", "prefix-${FLIPT_TEST_SUBSTITUTION}"},

		{"leading digit", "${9FLIPT_TEST_SUBSTITUTION}", "${9FLIPT_TEST_SUBSTITUTION}"},
		{"invalid punctuation", "${FLIPT-TEST}", "${FLIPT-TEST}"},

		{"number", 42, 42},

	}

}

func TestLoadEnvSubstitution(t *testing.T) {
	t.Setenv("FLIPT_TEST_LOG_ENCODING", "json")
	t.Setenv("FLIPT_TEST_LOG_LEVEL", "DEBUG")
	t.Setenv("FLIPT_TEST_HTTP_PORT", "8181")
	t.Setenv("_FLIPT_TEST_HOST9", "127.0.0.1")
	t.Setenv("FLIPT_TEST_CACHE_TTL", "2m")

	path := "./testdata/env_substitution.yml"
	result, err := Load(context.Background(), path)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, 8181, result.Config.Server.HTTPPort)
	require.Equal(t, "127.0.0.1", result.Config.Server.Host)
	require.Equal(t, LogEncodingJSON, result.Config.Log.Encoding)
	require.Equal(t, "DEBUG", result.Config.Log.Level)
	require.Equal(t, 2*time.Minute, result.Config.Cache.TTL)

	t.Run("configuration environment overrides win", func(t *testing.T) {
		t.Setenv("FLIPT_SERVER_HTTP_PORT", "8282")
		t.Setenv("FLIPT_LOG_ENCODING", "console")

		result, err := Load(context.Background(), path)
		require.NoError(t, err)
		require.Equal(t, 8282, result.Config.Server.HTTPPort)
		require.Equal(t, LogEncodingConsole, result.Config.Log.Encoding)
	})
}
